Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 98, verse 1:

﴿Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist﴾ [min] is explicative (lil-bayan). ﴿The People of the Book and the polytheists﴾ i.e., the worshippers of idols, conjoined to "the People of the Book" (ʿatf). ﴿Desisting﴾ is the predicate of "yakun" (lam yakun), i.e., departing from what they were upon. ﴿Until there came to them﴾ i.e., there came to them ﴿the clear proof﴾ i.e., the manifest evidence, and it is Muhammad ﷺ.
﴿A messenger from God﴾ is a substitute (badal) for "clear proof," and he is the Prophet (ﷺ), ﴿reciting purified pages﴾ free from falsehood.

{In it are written books} — written rulings, {upright}, i.e., straight; that is, it recites the content of that, which is the Qur'an. Among them are those who believed in it, and among them are those who disbelieved.

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 98, verse 4:

﴿And those who were given the Scripture did not become divided⦅...⦆﴾ in believing in him (ﷺ), ﴿except after the clear evidence had come to them﴾, i.e., he (ﷺ) or the Qur'an that came with him as a mu'jizah (miracle, a manifest sign that proves prophethood) for him. Before his coming (ﷺ), they were united in belief in him when he would come; but when he came, those among them who disbelieved in him envied him.

"And they were not commanded in their Scripture, the Torah and the Gospel, except that they should worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion" (ﷺ not here) — from shirk (polytheism). "Hunafa'" (upright, inclining away from falsehood): following the religion of Ibrahim and the religion of Muhammad (ﷺ) when he comes; so how did they disbelieve in him? "And establish the prayer and give the zakat; and that is the upright religion" (al-millah al-qayyimah), meaning the straight religion.

Notes on the grammar: the phrase أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهُ ("that they worship Him", أن يعبدوه) — the particle "an" (أنْ, "that") was deleted and the lam (اللَّام, "the lam of purpose") was added, so that the sense is "li-ya'budu" (in order that they worship).

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 98, verse 6:

﴿Indeed, those who disbelieved from among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hellfire, abiding eternally therein.﴾ [Khalidin fiha] is a circumstantial clause (hal muqaddara), meaning: their abiding therein is decreed by Allah, the Exalted. ﴿Those are the worst of creation.﴾

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 98, verse 7:

﴿Indeed, those who believed and did righteous deeds — they are the best of creation.﴾ (the creation)

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 98, verse 8:

﴿Their reward with their Lord is Gardens of Eden (jannat ʿAdn), [in which they will] abide;﴾ [their abiding (iqamah) is] ﴿Allah is pleased with them﴾ for their obedience to Him, ﴿and they are pleased with Him﴾ for His reward. ﴿That is for whoever fears his Lord﴾ fears His punishment, so he refrains from disobeying Him, exalted is He.
